product_idea: Local Construction & Maintenance Project Intelligence platform for AU market. Aggregate council DA portals, government tender boards (AusTender, eTendering NSW, VendorPanel), private-sector planning apps, and news sources into a single dashboard. Layer AI on top to flag relevant projects per user (e.g. 'alert me to all roof-replacement jobs in Western Sydney over $200k'). Sell to subcontractors, suppliers, and trade businesses who currently spend hours on this manually or pay for legacy services like Cordell Connect (CoreLogic) and BCI Central — both expensive and dated. MVP shape: $200–500/month per seat, sold to construction businesses. AU-first, expand globally. Risks: data sources change formats, scraping legal grey areas (stick to public/government data initially).
wedge_sentence: The Sunday-night roofing DA digest for Sydney subbies — 15 LGAs, 5–15 leads, AUD 199/mo, signup in 60 seconds.
icp: Sydney roofing owner-operator, 4–15 staff, AUD 1.5–8M revenue, residential strata + light commercial, NSW Class RT or Roof Plumbing licence, MBA NSW or HIA member.
anti_axis: Will not compete on coverage breadth, multi-trade filters, head-contractor tender flow, contact-data enrichment, or free-tier race-to-zero.
